name: Team objective versus local gain
structure: Compare a personal scoring or development action against partner's next attainable route.
conditions: A local hold could block a more valuable allied conquest.
failure_case: Partner may be unable to take the open field; opponent can exploit vacancy.
original_exercise_seed: In practice, ask whether protecting a lead on one field makes the other player's next turn worse.
novelty: Related mechanism; team-format extension, not independently certified.

name: Complementary deck architecture
structure: Allocate proactive threats and flexible support across two inventories; measure shared coverage.
conditions: Partners have distinct roles and adequate independent fallbacks.
failure_case: Both decks rely on the other's missing opening piece.
original_exercise_seed: A tester replaces one redundant defensive slot with a threat that works when the partner misses development.
novelty: Related mechanism; team-format extension, not independently certified.

name: Asymmetric development horizon
structure: Early player maintains scoring access until partner's later payoff becomes viable.
conditions: Bridge duration fits actual remaining clock and score.
failure_case: Delayed payoff arrives after the match is effectively lost.
original_exercise_seed: The pair compares a three-turn setup with a faster route while already behind.
novelty: Related mechanism; team-format extension, not independently certified.

name: Joint resource reservation
structure: Maintain separate budgets and map partner-turn reaction windows before spending.
conditions: Relevant effects and timing verified; players agree which threats justify expenditure.
failure_case: Reserving everything sacrifices development; spending everything leaves no response.
original_exercise_seed: One player asks how much interaction remains if both spend on development.
novelty: Related mechanism; team-format extension, not independently certified.

name: Multi-opponent answer efficiency
structure: Assess an answer by distribution of valid targets across both opposing boards.
conditions: Target scope and conditions checked against effective card text.
failure_case: An effect counts only the caster's opponent or excludes a target.
original_exercise_seed: Compare two independent single-target answers with one conditional wider answer; check who pays and what is actually affected.
novelty: Related mechanism; team-format extension, not independently certified.

name: Seat assignment as construction input
structure: Choose role order after modeling opening resource asymmetry and early curve.
conditions: Correct first-turn rules for event and version.
failure_case: A favorable opening comes at the cost of losing a key battlefield.
original_exercise_seed: Two partners test the same decks from reversed seats.
novelty: Related mechanism; team-format extension, not independently certified.

name: Battlefield sacrifice allocation
structure: Distribute essential fields toward seats less likely to lose their selection.
conditions: Unique field constraints and actual setup rules verified.
failure_case: Opponent determines a different order or the random field is unfavorable.
original_exercise_seed: The duo compares packages under every possible removed-field seat.
novelty: Related mechanism; team-format extension, not independently certified.

name: Pre-game sideboard coordination
structure: Interpret revealed opposing Legends; allocate scarce answer slots jointly before hidden deck contents are known.
conditions: BO1 sideboard procedure applicable.
failure_case: Public signals are ambiguous or the relevant counter is redundant.
original_exercise_seed: One teammate covers equipment while the other retains pressure instead of both overboarding.
novelty: Related mechanism; team-format extension, not independently certified.

name: False archetype prior
structure: Choose a legitimate deck whose public identity suggests another threat; exploit incorrect opponent preparation.
conditions: No illegal deception; opponent prior is an estimate.
failure_case: Opponents keep broad answers or correctly identify the list.
original_exercise_seed: A practice opponent brings narrow interaction for a payoff absent from the registered list.
novelty: Related mechanism; team-format extension, not independently certified.

name: Evidence-driven belief revision
structure: Update archetype hypotheses as observed actions diverge from initial assumptions.
conditions: Observe public plays; maintain several explanations.
failure_case: A single unusual card is overinterpreted.
original_exercise_seed: An opponent sees an unexpected early unit and revises, rather than discards, the original read.
novelty: Related mechanism; team-format extension, not independently certified.

name: Ally information partition
structure: Separate team-private hand knowledge from opponent-visible state; combine only permitted information.
conditions: Sharing permitted at event; knowledge acquired explicitly.
failure_case: A viewpoint character knows a card never shown to them.
original_exercise_seed: A player asks whether their partner actually has protection before taking a risk.
novelty: Related mechanism; team-format extension, not independently certified.

name: Ownership wording boundary
structure: Distinguish team-relative effects from effects limited to an object's controller.
conditions: Exact current wording and errata checked.
failure_case: The planned synergy depends on the wrong controller.
original_exercise_seed: Two testers discover their proposed interaction does not extend to an allied object.
novelty: Related mechanism; team-format extension, not independently certified.

name: Support authorization and timing
structure: Coordinate legal response opportunities before a teammate commits to action.
conditions: Priority, focus, timing and costs checked.
failure_case: Assistance is assumed without a legal window or available resources.
original_exercise_seed: A player asks for a response window before committing the next action.
novelty: Related mechanism; team-format extension, not independently certified.

name: Occupation versus scoring access
structure: Separate current board occupancy, control history and next legal scoring opportunity.
conditions: Apply dated scoring rules and intervening opposing actions.
failure_case: Withdrawal fails to create a legal score or hands initiative to opponents.
original_exercise_seed: Construct two conditional routes through the same field and verify legal scoring separately.
novelty: Related mechanism; team-format extension, not independently certified.

name: Handoff risk
structure: Release control only after evaluating opponent intervention and allied arrival.
conditions: Partner can reach the field, and opponent has independent choices.
failure_case: Opponent takes or reinforces it before ally's turn.
original_exercise_seed: The team rehearses the rival's strongest response to a proposed handoff.
novelty: Related mechanism; team-format extension, not independently certified.

name: Alternative finish routes
structure: Keep multiple conditional scoring endpoints credible instead of relying on one finisher.
conditions: Final-point conditions, timing and exact effects verified.
failure_case: All alternatives share the same vulnerable prerequisite.
original_exercise_seed: Compare a defensive hold route with a multi-field route at the same near-win score.
novelty: Related mechanism; team-format extension, not independently certified.

name: Clock-conditioned archetype fit
structure: Evaluate setup length and pace against event timing and scoring margin.
conditions: Dated time-out policy and actual remaining time.
failure_case: Fast pressure sacrifices too much resilience; clock policy differs.
original_exercise_seed: At a practice checkpoint the duo must choose development or immediate scoring.
novelty: Related mechanism; team-format extension, not independently certified.

name: Time-efficient communication
structure: Agree on short decision requests, independent responsibilities and stop conditions.
conditions: Event communication and slow-play rules respected.
failure_case: Discussion consumes time without improving the decision.
original_exercise_seed: Test a single question for shared decisions instead of debating every routine action.
novelty: Related mechanism; team-format extension, not independently certified.

name: Disagreement under joint liability
structure: Expose different assumptions, choose an action, share outcome and review evidence.
conditions: Both partners retain independent judgment.
failure_case: One person controls every decision or blames the other solely because of result.
original_exercise_seed: Partners disagree about holding a reserve and compare pre-action assumptions afterward.
novelty: Related mechanism; team-format extension, not independently certified.

name: Attention allocation
structure: Divide awareness of own board, partner's requests and rival threat windows.
conditions: Each player maintains their own state and responsibilities.
failure_case: Over-monitoring partner causes missed actions or overlooked resources.
original_exercise_seed: A teammate who is asked for help checks their own remaining plan before responding.
novelty: Related mechanism; team-format extension, not independently certified.

name: Cross-player mobility support
structure: Use a support role to alter the ally's available positional routes.
conditions: Exact ability scope, targets and movement restrictions confirmed.
failure_case: Support cannot legally move the object or cannot pay the cost.
original_exercise_seed: In an abstract rehearsal, compare direct development with supported repositioning.
novelty: Related mechanism; team-format extension, not independently certified.

name: Pressure-protection role split
structure: Proactive pilot creates threats; partner uses independently viable protection or recovery.
conditions: Threats are real and protection remains legal and affordable.
failure_case: The threat player overextends because protection is presumed.
original_exercise_seed: One partner presents a threat and the other names the specific response class they can cover.
novelty: Related mechanism; team-format extension, not independently certified.

name: Early engine versus wipe exposure
structure: Compare value of sustained engine with vulnerability to common broad disruption.
conditions: Actual cards and opposition confirmed.
failure_case: Overinvestment makes a single reset decisive.
original_exercise_seed: A duo compares holding one strong position against spreading into two.
novelty: Related mechanism; team-format extension, not independently certified.

name: Independent list quality fallback
structure: Prefer robust independent plans when elaborate cooperation is unreliable.
conditions: Pair remains legal and collectively covers plausible threats.
failure_case: Independent strong decks conflict over objectives or fields.
original_exercise_seed: Two players compare a simple good-stuff pairing against a synergy-dependent build.
novelty: Related mechanism; team-format extension, not independently certified.

name: Shared payoff multiplication
structure: Evaluate team-wide bonuses and shared payoff conditions before construction.
conditions: Effective card text actually reaches allied objects.
failure_case: Assumed cross-player bonus only applies to own units.
original_exercise_seed: Test an otherwise marginal piece with and without a verified allied payoff.
novelty: Related mechanism; team-format extension, not independently certified.

name: Dependency concentration
structure: One pilot protects a fragile combo while the other supplies required pieces.
conditions: Disruption and clock costs considered; exact loop verified.
failure_case: One targeted interruption invalidates both players' plans.
original_exercise_seed: A team lists which single missing prerequisite makes the entire strategy fail.
novelty: Related mechanism; team-format extension, not independently certified.

name: Conditional resource recovery
structure: Compare recurring resource recovery with immediate expenditure across future joint actions.
conditions: Exact recovery limits verified.
failure_case: Engine is removed or recursion cannot reach the required card.
original_exercise_seed: A support pilot chooses whether to save a recovery option for a later contested turn.
novelty: Related mechanism; team-format extension, not independently certified.

name: Prize-driven format selection
structure: Separate event reward incentives from learning, entry cost and enjoyment.
conditions: Prize structure and attendance verified independently.
failure_case: Anecdotal ticket payouts treated as expected profit.
original_exercise_seed: A pair decides whether a side event is worth entering after checking posted rewards.
novelty: Related mechanism; team-format extension, not independently certified.

name: Judge consultation as team skill
structure: Resolve scope uncertainty through official sources and judge procedure before relying on the interaction.
conditions: No invented ruling or penalties.
failure_case: Players treat an informal opinion as authority.
original_exercise_seed: A practice pair marks a disputed interaction unresolved until a judge or official text settles it.
novelty: Related mechanism; team-format extension, not independently certified.

name: Post-match counterfactual review
structure: Identify earliest decision that changed the available team route; compare alternatives with known information.
conditions: Record both viewpoints and avoid outcome bias.
failure_case: Loss is blamed on the most visible final action without checking prerequisites.
original_exercise_seed: Partners replay the decision where their resource plans first diverged.
novelty: Related mechanism; team-format extension, not independently certified.
